|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard [[Punishing One]], and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. May not be attacked. Immune to [[Fallen Portal]].
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-10-Dengar.png]]). The current text is [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. May not be attacked. Immune to Fallen Portal.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “10” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) removed “May not be attacked.”. PC-E1 text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. Immune to Fallen Portal.”<ref name="cl-1220_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-dengar-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. May not be attacked. Immune to Fallen Portal.” '''What changed:''' “May not be attacked.” returns. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual2-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual2-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034549/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual2-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “10” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 7)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=7, page 7. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. May not be attacked. Immune to Fallen Portal.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “10”). GEMP's current card plays this text: Dengar may not be attacked (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
